subject: New-joiner vetting evidence & training remediation plan — compact handoff
messages:
From: security@acmehealth.com
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: onboarding/offboarding evidence bundle (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call earlier. Our SOC2 reviewer asked for a compact evidence bundle demonstrating Redwood's personnel controls for new joiners and leavers. Specifically we need:

- confirmation that security training is completed for new hires (sample certs),
- background check vendor summary and redacted results for a small cohort,
- deprovisioning checklist / runbook and time-to-remove examples,
- your remediation plan for incomplete training (how you enforce/monitor),
- a mapping to the SIG control IDs or a short CAIQ pointer if you have it.

Can you get a short package over by EOD Friday (2026-11-13)? A zipped folder with clear filenames is ideal. If there are any PII constraints, a redacted CSV with a proof-of-redaction sample will work for the cohort.

Thanks — send to security@acmehealth.com and cc our auditor (auditor@acmehealth.com) if possible.

Regards,
Maya Patel
Acme Health — Information Security

---
Note: Please also include the HR attestation (signed) if available.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:05:13 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/offboarding evidence bundle (SOC2/SIG)

Maya — thanks for the clear ask. We can assemble a compact bundle and will include the SIG/CAIQ cross-reference you requested. A couple quick clarifying Qs before we package:

1) For the background checks, do you want us to include the vendor raw report or only a redacted summary? We typically provide a redacted summary + a hashed identifier for chain-of-custody.
2) Which cohort size is acceptable for your auditor? We can provide a 3-person sample or a 10-person sample.

Plan: Laura will pull the HR attestation and a redacted roster. Irene will prepare the training certs and deprovisioning runbook extract. I’ll assemble into a zip and send a DocuSign link for HR attestation.

Target delivery: 2026-11-12 by EOD Pacific — would that work? If you still need Friday we can push to 11/13.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:43:50 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/offboarding evidence bundle (SOC2/SIG) — proposed package and remediation steps

Ben / Laura — adding the security side of the pack and a proposed remediation workflow. I’m attaching a small set of artifacts for the sample cohort:

Attachments (will include in final zip):
- redaction-sample-roster-20261112.csv (roster with PII redacted; retains internal employee ID hashes)
- background-check-summary-20261112.pdf (vendor summary w/ result flags, redacted names)
- newhire-training-certificates-20261112.zip (PDF certs for sample cohort)
- deprovisioning-runbook-20261112.md (excerpt of our runbook showing steps + SLOs)

Remediation plan (short):
- Training enforcement: new hires automatically placed into a "New Joiner" Okta group that restricts access to production until mandatory courses complete. Compliance rule triggers daily reminder emails for outstanding courses; after 7 days, access to non-essential tooling is removed until completion.
- Tracking & verification: weekly audit job exports completion counts; failures generate tickets to HR via PagerDuty integration.
- Background checks: vendor (ClearTrace) results are ingested into HRIS; any flags create a follow-up workflow with hiring manager and security.

SIG mapping: I will include a 1-page mapping doc for personnel-related SIG rows (PS-1, PS-3, PS-7) and point to our CAIQ answers. That will be in the zip as "sig-personnel-mapping-20261112.pdf".

Timing: I can assemble the zip by tomorrow (11/12) noon PT. Laura — can you provide a signed HR attestation (simple statement that checks were completed and retention policy applies) so we can route it through DocuSign?

Irene
Head of Security (Onboarding Controls)
Irene Choi — irene_choi@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:27:04 -0800
Subject: Evidence bundle: onboarding & offboarding sample + remediation plan (ACME delivery)

Maya — attached is a compact evidence bundle for the sample cohort. Contents:

- newhire-training-certificates-20261112.zip (3 PDFs; course completion stamps)
- background-check-summary-20261112.pdf (redacted vendor summary)
- deprovisioning-runbook-20261112.md (runbook excerpt showing steps + time-to-remove examples)
- redaction-sample-roster-20261112.csv (redacted roster with hashed IDs)
- sig-personnel-mapping-20261112.pdf (1-page mapping to SIG rows)

We’ve also created a short remediation timeline: weekly reminders for outstanding training; gating via Okta group for production access; escalations to HR at day 7; manual override only by VP People.

HR attestation: Laura has signed the attestation and routed it via DocuSign here: https://app.docusign.com/sign/EX-ACME-48392. Please let us know if you need the executed copy exported and attached to the bundle.

A few notes: background vendor used was ClearTrace; for chain-of-custody we include internal hash IDs in the CSV. If ACME’s auditor needs raw vendor reports we’ll need an NDA addendum — happy to discuss.

Ben Carter
Attachments: newhire-training-certificates-20261112.zip (zip), background-check-summary-20261112.pdf (pdf), deprovisioning-runbook-20261112.md (text), redaction-sample-roster-20261112.csv (csv), sig-personnel-mapping-20261112.pdf (pdf)

From: Maya Patel <security@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: auditor@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence bundle: onboarding & offboarding sample + remediation plan (ACME delivery)

Ben / Irene / Laura — thanks, this looks thorough and well packaged. A couple of follow-ups from the auditor:

1) Could you include a redaction-proof for the roster showing the redaction process (screenshot or script output) so the auditor can verify it was deterministic?
2) We need the executed HR attestation turned into a PDF and attached in the bundle (the DocuSign link is fine but auditors prefer an exported copy).

If you can add those two items by EOD Monday (2026-11-15) we’ll accept the sample and move forward to a short SIG spreadsheet exchange.

Maya
Acme Health — Information Security
